posting_text:
Job Title: CNC Programmer / Manufacturing Engineer
Location: Kenosha, WI
Duration: 6-month contract-to-hire
Pay Rate: $38 - $46/hr W2
Client: Tier 1 automotive supplier (name withheld)

Job Duties:
- Write and prove out CNC programs for 4- and 5-axis machining centers
- Create fixtures and setup sheets in SolidWorks
- Support PPAP submissions and respond to customer 8D requests
- Perform other duties as required

Skills Required:
- 3+ years of G-code programming on Haas or Mazak equipment
- Mastercam or Esprit CAM experience
- Ability to read prints with GD&T
- Experience in an IATF 16949 environment

Skills Preferred:
- Six Sigma Green Belt
- ERP experience (Plex or SAP)
- Familiarity with SPC software

About Us:
Precision Talent Partners is a staffing firm specializing in manufacturing talent. We've placed over 4,000 SolidWorks, CNC and PLC professionals since 2009. Benefits for contract employees include medical, dental, and 401(k).

Precision Talent Partners is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
